_comment: Template only. The real google-services.json is downloaded from the Firebase
console (Project settings -> Your apps -> Android) and is gitignored, because
it is deployment configuration rather than source.
package_name MUST equal the applicationId in android/app/build.gradle --
currently com.beepmydevice. The Google Services Gradle plugin fails the build
with 'No matching client found for package name' when they differ, which is
the usual reason a fresh Firebase setup will not compile.
See docs/PUSH_SETUP.md for the full walkthrough.
